newsitem.title: USA: Neiman Marcus Q2 net short of expectations.
newsitem.headline: Neiman Marcus Q2 net short of expectations.

text.p: Neiman Marcus Group Inc said Thursday earnings per share for its second quarter ending February 1 would, based on current estimates, approximate $0.50 per share, representing a 22 percent gain from the $0.41 earned a year earlier but falling somewhat short of the company's previous expectations.

The company said it still anticipates a strong earnings gain for the quarter and for the full fiscal year ending August 2; however, lower than anticipated revenues and gross margins in the recent holiday selling season have produced somewhat reduced expectations for the current quarter.
Neiman Marcus also reported that comparable sales for the five-weeks ended January 4 declined 0.6 percent from the five weeks ended December 30, 1996.
The Neiman Marcus Group consists of three operating units: Neiman Marcus Stores, NM Direct and Bergdorf Goodman.
Harcourt General Inc owns about 53 percent of the outstanding common equity in Neiman Marcus Group.
